items.passageEn: Yesterday was a busy day. My brother and I had a test in the morning. We were tired, but we helped each other with our homework. Today is Saturday. My brother has a soccer game, so I had to get up early. What am I doing now? I'm watching his game!
items.passageZh: 昨天很忙。我和我的兄弟早上有考試。我們很累，但還是互相幫忙寫功課。今天是星期六，我的兄弟有一場足球賽，所以我得早起。我現在在做什麼？我在看他的比賽！

referenceEn: I have to go home early today.
rubricZh: 「得、必須」可用 have to＋原形（例如 have to go），寫 must 也正確
主詞是 I，用 have to 時不寫 has to

items.promptZh: 那兩個孩子正看著對方。
referenceEn: The two kids are looking at each other.
The two children are looking at each other.
rubricZh: each other 放在動詞或介系詞後面當受詞（例如 look at each other）
「正」用現在進行式（例如 are looking）
